notes.title: Update 1.02 Released
notes.content:
Please restart your steam client.

<------------------IMPORTANT------------------>
If you play the game in German you switch back to English and change to German again.

Patch notes:

- removed whitening effect on selected Enemies and Actors to improve performance in battle.
- fixed a door transferring player to the wrong map in the Treehouse.
- Game no longer crash in the final battle, if the entire party got disabled.
- Fixed a rare bug, that cause the game to crash at the beginning of the final 
  battle.
- Saving and reloading after escaping should no longer freeze certain enemies.

notes.title: Update 1.01 Released
notes.content:
Please restart your steam client.

<------------------IMPORTANT------------------>
If you play the game in german you switch back to english and change to german again.

Patchnotes

- Poison Coating will now appear in Selene's Spell book after it was learned.
- Game no longer crash if Simon join the party while the inventory is full.
- Looting all should no longer freeze the game.
- A Bug was fixed which turned the player characters invisible, when a living 
  armor was beaten with certain skills.
- Fixed several translation issues
